text: Ekadashi, the eleventh day, was set aside by our elders as a special day to turn our attention inward.
It was a time to gently shift focus away from external appetites and towards remembrance.
The true purpose was never about an empty stomach, but rather the quiet space it created for deeper reflection.
You might find it peaceful to chant 'Om Namo Narayanaya' as you go about your daily work, or perhaps read a few names from the Vishnu Sahasranamam.
In the evening, light a deepam and take one still minute in front of it, simply being present.
